# Income Phase: phased card-effect animations (coin grids, synergy/rep/event contributions)

**Priority: High** | **Type: Feature** | **Marked for producer review**

## Objective

When the turn ends and the IncomePhase resolves, step through all income card effects one at a time, in a phase-based order and pacing that reads clearly to the player. Starting with base income, each affected business/community-space card shows its income coins "counting out" into a coin grid rendered on the card; then synergy, reputation, event, and upcoming-card contributions either fly coins into that grid or (for negative effects) fly coins out. This replaces the current single-fly-to-HUD collection with a legible, per-contribution breakdown.

## Users & User Stories

- **Player** — "When I end my turn I want to *see* where my income came from — how much each business produced on its own, how much came from synergy and reputation, and how much events changed—so the economy feels legible and satisfying."
- **Player (reduced motion)** — "I still want to follow the phases and see the contributed amounts, but without the coin flights."

## Problem statement

End-of-turn income is currently collapsed into a single coin-per-slot that arcs to the HUD counter (CG-0MSRGTUSK003GDGE). The player cannot tell how much came from base income vs synergy vs reputation vs event modifiers, which undermines the "watch your town pay out" moment.

## Desired change

Rework the income-collection presentation into a phase-based, per-card coin-grid animation:

1. **Base income "counts out" of each card** — for each producing business/community-space, the card's base income (rounded to nearest 0.5 after this phase) appears as coins (full coin per whole 0.5; half coin for a remainder) that animate out of the card into a coin **grid rendered on the card**. Coins accumulate on the card across phases.
2. **Synergy coins fly in from the synergy line** — coins from the synergy multiplier fly from the synergy line (shared `synergyLineEndpoints` geometry) into the affected card's grid.
3. **Reputation coins fly in from the HUD** — coins from the reputation multiplier fly from the reputation score HUD into the grid.
4. **Event-card effects** — any event card (active duration effects, e.g. Flu Outbreak 0.8×) that affects income flies coins in (boost) or out (reduction) to/from the affected business cards. Duration effects are indicated via animated text lines (see below); single-turn effects just fly the coins.
5. **Upcoming cards** — upcoming cards that affect income either fly coins in, or fly coins out (from the business to the upcoming card, where they disappear).
6. **Grid-to-HUD collection** — at the end of the income step, the accumulated coins on each card's grid fly to the HUD coins counter (reusing/extending the existing fly-to-HUD + final "+total" pop behaviour).

**Coin grid packing (per user):** start as a 5×3 grid; when space runs out, overlap/shrink the coins to fit 10×3, then 15×3, etc. Exact packing "whatever works well" — 3 rows with columns growing (5/10/15...) and shrinking coin size / overlap as needed.

**Rounding (per user, Q8):** each *phase* rounds its own portion to the nearest 0.5 for the coins shown in the grid. The HUD / credited total still uses the exact fractional value (current behaviour preserved).

**Phasing (per user, Q3):** phase-based — all cards show base alongside, then all cards' synergy, then all cards' reputation, then each event, then upcoming-card effects. Each phase lasts ~2–3 seconds. **Reduced motion keeps the phases (same sequence + pacing) but removes the coin animation** (no flights / count-out tweens); the per-phase rounded values still appear.

**Duration-effect text lines (Upcoming panel):** for event cards with a duration, indicate their effect via an animated text line — on a *new* card the effect text animates in one letter at a time with a grow/shrink animation. Then, for each line (new and pre-existing), coins fly to/from the affected business cards. *(The Upcoming-deck-as-face-down-single-card redesign that frees the panel space is a SEPARATE work item — CG-0MSXIQDI4007K6N0 is unrelated (HUD decimals); the deck redesign has no ID yet and is out of scope here.)* This item assumes the panel already has room for these effect lines; if it does not yet, this item proceeds with the best available placement and the deck redesign is tracked separately.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. End-of-turn income walks through phases in order (base → synergy → reputation → events → upcoming), each ~2–3s, with on-card coin grids that accumulate rounded coins per phase (nearest 0.5 per phase).
2. Base coins "count out" of each producing card into its grid; synergy coins fly in from the synergy line; reputation coins fly in from the reputation HUD; event/upcoming effects fly coins in or out to/from the appropriate cards.
3. Grid packing scales from 5×3 to 10×3 to 15×3 by shrinking/overlapping coins as space requires; overflow is visible, not clipped.
4. At the end, grid coins fly to the HUD coins counter with the existing final "+total" pop and coin-pop SFX (extending CG-0MSRGTUSK003GDGE); the credited HUD total is unchanged (exact fractional total preserved).
5. Duration-effect events show an animated effect line (one-letter grow/shrink reveal for new cards) with coins flying to/from affected businesses; single-turn events just fly coins.
6. Reduced motion keeps the same phases and pacing but strips coin animations (text/phase progression only); replay/headless modes are unaffected (no rendering/audio — documented exemption).
7. New/extended unit + browser tests cover phase ordering, per-phase rounding, grid packing stress (15×3+), event/upcoming fly-in/out, and reduced-motion path.
8. All related documentation updated (code comments, `docs/main-street/ux-visual-audio.md`, scene README).

## Constraints

- Presentation-only VFX: never mutates game state, transcript, or turn flow (AGENTS.md rule 8). Must remain non-blocking like the current animation (runs inside the turn-advance window; failures swallowed).
- Reuse existing helpers: `moveGameObject`, `popTextOrIcon`, `SoundManager`/`SFX_KEYS` (`COMMON_SFX_KEYS` convention), `synergyLineEndpoints`, per-slot data from `applyIncome()`/`IncomeResult.breakdown`.
- Respect reduced-motion (SettingsStore / `prefers-reduced-motion`) and headless/replay exemption.
- No new SFX keys unless unavoidable; prefer existing `sfx-coin-pop` etc.
- Must build on / not regress CG-0MSRGTUSK003GDGE (existing fly-to-HUD) and CG-0MSRGUFZ2001ELSR (synergy formation animation).

## Existing state

- `applyIncome()` in `MainStreetAdjacency.ts` returns `IncomeResult.breakdown` (`SlotIncome[]`: `slotIndex`, `businessName`, `baseIncome`, `synergyBonus`, `total`) + `handSynergyTotal`; applies per-slot `income-multiplier` active effects, then the reputation multiplier to the total (exact fractional coins).
- `MainStreetAnimator.animateIncomeCollection()` (from CG-0MSRGTUSK003GDGE) flies one coin per producing slot + rep pips to HUD, with final pop; `incomeCollectionActive` flag suppresses the immediate HUD delta pop.
- `synergyLineEndpoints()` shared by renderer + animator for synergy-line geometry (p1/p2/mid).
- `ActiveEffect` system (`income-multiplier` / `rep-multiplier`) with `applyActiveEffectMultiplier()`; duration events e.g. Flu Outbreak (0.8×/5 turns), Recession (0.7×/4), Tourist Season (1.15×/3), Labor Shortage (0.9×/3).
- The "Upcoming" panel (`MainStreetRenderer`) shows the incident queue (2 face-up cards + deck) + ⚠ active-effect duration lines.
- HUD geometry mirrors: coins label at `gameW*0.25 + 70`, rep label at strip centre (`gameW*0.5`), `hudY` from layout.

## Key Files

- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetAnimator.ts` — new `animateIncomePhases()` (or rework `animateIncomeCollection`) implementing the phased coin-grid + fly-in/out sequence; grid-packing helper.
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetAdjacency.ts` — expose/derive per-slot base/synergy/rep/event contribution breakdown for the phases (likely extend `applyIncome`/`IncomeResult` with richer per-phase data).
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngine.ts` — `processEndOfTurn()` / `applyIncome()` — surface per-phase contributions (base, synergy, rep from `applyReputationMultiplier`, event deltas) for the animation.
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetDifficulty.ts` — `reputationCoinMultiplier()` — source of the rep-coins fly-in amount.
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetCards.ts` / `activeEffects` — identify income-affecting event/upcoming cards for fly-in/out.
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetRenderer.ts` — Upcoming panel effect-line placement; HUD target coords; on-card grid anchoring.
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetTurnController.ts` — orchestrate the phased animation in `endTurn()` income presentation.
- `src/core-engine/ActiveEffect.ts` — reference for `income-multiplier` / `applyActiveEffectMultiplier`.
- `tests/main-street/` — phase-ordering, rounding, grid-packing, reduced-motion tests.

## Risks & assumptions

- **Grid space / readability** — on-card coin grids may visually clutter small card faces; the 5×3→10×3→15×3 overlap/shrink packing may become hard to read at high income. Mitigate: half-coin vs full-coin sizing, controlled overlap, overflow label. (Spike if needed.)
- **Phase timing vs turn pacing** — 2–3s × several phases could lengthen end-of-turn. Reduced-motion retains phases; keep total within acceptable bounds and non-blocking. Player may find 5+ phases too slow — may need a cap/condense for cards with no contributions in a phase.
- **Rounding drift** — per-phase nearest-0.5 rounding means displayed coins may not sum exactly to the exact credited fractional total; the HUD shows the exact total (documented as intended, Q8).
- **Panel space for effect lines** — the Upcoming-deck redesign (face-down single deck) that frees space is a separate work item; if space isn't ready, effect lines may need a temporary placement. Track the deck redesign as a child/related item.
- **Scope creep** — remain a presentation-only income-animation feature; do not include the deck redesign, Community Favour, HUD decimals, or other economy changes. Log extra opportunities as linked work items, not scope.

## Related work

- CG-0MSRGTUSK003GDGE "Animate end-of-turn income collection (coin fly-to-HUD)" (completed) — base the phased animation on this.
- CG-0MSRGUFZ2001ELSR "Synergy link formation animation" (completed) — synergy-line geometry reuse.
- CG-0MSX2PI7X002014B / CG-0MSX2PNSJ000YDM0 "synergyLineEndpoints" — shared synergy geometry helper.
- CG-0MSQJ244M0055X7S "Group C: Investment events — new duration types" — duration `income-multiplier`/`rep-multiplier` events (Flu Outbreak, Tourist Season, etc.) that produce the effect lines.
- CG-0MSXIQDI4007K6N0 "Show HUD bar money and reputation to 2 decimal places" (open) — touches HUD numeric display; related but out of scope.
- Upcoming-deck redesign (face-down single card) — separate work item (no ID yet); prerequisite for freeing Upcoming panel space.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

- Q1 (Map → user): "End state of the coin grid after all coins land?" — Answer (user): "(a) Grid is intermediate — coins then fly from each card to the HUD counter, replacing the current per-slot fly-to-HUD; the grid visualizes the breakdown, then the existing collection animation finishes the job." Source: interactive reply.
- Q2 (Map → user): "What are 'upcoming cards that affect income'?" — Answer (user): "Not all cards have a duration effect, some are single turn. For duration cards we need an effect indication (space freed by the Upcoming-deck redesign). If a new card, its effect text animates in (one letter at a time, grow/shrink). Then for each line (new + old) coins fly to/from the affected businesses. Single-turn cards simply fly the coins." Source: interactive reply.
- Q3 (Map → user): "Sequencing/pacing?" — Answer (user): "Phase based; each phase 2–3 seconds. Reduced motion keeps the phases but removes the animations." Source: interactive reply.
- Q4 (Map → user): "Grid capacity & card space + packing?" — Answer (user): "5×3 grid to start; overlap/shift coins to enable 10×3, then 15×3, etc." Source: interactive reply.
- Q5 (Map → user): "Fractional rounding for portions?" — Answer (user): "Round for the total after each phase." Source: interactive reply.
- Q6 (Map → user): "Is the Upcoming-deck redesign part of this item?" — Answer (user): "It is another work item." Source: interactive reply.
- Q7 (Map → user): "Exact 5×3→10×3→15×3 packing rule?" — Answer (user): "Whatever works well." Source: interactive reply.
- Q8 (Map → user): "Round per phase means each phase rounds its own coins to nearest 0.5 independently?" — Answer (user): "confirm." Source: interactive reply.
- Q9 (Map → user): "Base coins stay on the card as grid anchor; at end grid coins fly to HUD?" — Answer (user): "confirm." Source: interactive reply.

## Mini-review record (agent, five stages)

- **1. Completeness:** Problem, users, ACs, constraints present. ACs cover phase ordering/rounding, per-contribution fly-in/out, grid packing stress, event text lines, reduced-motion, tests, docs. Added a grid-overflow visibility AC (never clipped) and a build/doc AC.
- **2. Capture fidelity:** All user answers (Q1–Q9) captured verbatim in the Appendix; phased/pacing/reduced-motion (Q3), 5×3→10×3→15×3 packing + "whatever works well" (Q4/Q7), per-phase total rounding (Q5/Q8), deck redesign out of scope (Q6), base-counts-out + grid-intermediate-then-fly-to-HUD (Q1/Q9). No intent altered.
- **3. Related-work & traceability:** Key precedents linked (CG-0MSRGTUSK003GDGE, CG-0MSRGUFZ2001ELSR, CG-0MSX2PI7X002014B/CG-0MSX2PNSJ000YDM0, CG-0MSQJ244M0055X7S). find-related automated report appended; its hits are mostly tangential (hand animation, Coloretto spacing) and do not alter scope.
- **4. Risks & assumptions:** Added grid-readability, phase-timing/turn-pacing, per-phase rounding drift, Upcoming-panel space (deck redesign out of scope), and a scope-creep guard. Each has a mitigation.
- **5. Polish & handoff:** Tightened objective to "phase-based, per-card coin grid + fly-in/out" with measurable ACs; documented exact credited total preserved (Q8); highlighted which helpers to reuse and the separate deck-redesign work item.

## Related work (automated report)

Automated find-related report appended to this item's description (.worklog/tmp/find-related-full-CG-0MT23O6W8003AXWJ.md) — hits: CG-0MS7UEUL000610A2 (buy-card hand animation, tangential), CG-0MSJFUGB5005YBK8 (Coloretto tableau spacing, tangential), CG-0MRXYHNHB006F0U9 (synergy bonus on cards, related). Manual related-work section above lists the truly-direct precedents.

**Research summary:** Reviewed `applyIncome()`/`IncomeResult.breakdown` (per-slot base/synergy, per-slot income-multiplier, then total rep multiplier), `MainStreetAnimator.animateIncomeCollection()` and its `incomeCollectionActive` suppression, `synergyLineEndpoints` shared geometry, `ActiveEffect`/`applyActiveEffectMultiplier` for duration events, `reputationCoinMultiplier()` in MainStreetDifficulty (divisor 20, max 3.0), and the Upcoming panel renderer. Related completed items CG-0MSRGTUSK003GDGE, CG-0MSRGUFZ2001ELSR, CG-0MSQJ244M0055X7S guide the design.

# Intake Brief — Remove 'Market cycled...' activity log (CG-0MT5VXSSQ003O5ZC)

## Problem statement

Main Street's end-of-turn market cycling emits a noisy `Market cycled: N unpurchased cards moved to discard` entry on every turn. This adds little player value and clutters the activity log. The entry should be removed so the log only surfaces player-meaningful events.

## Users

- **Player** — reads the activity log to understand what happened each turn (purchases, income, events, gains/losses); does not want routine housekeeping noise.
- **Developer/QA** — validates log output against expectations; fewer spurious entries makes log assertions stable.

### User stories

- As a player, I want the activity log to omit routine `Market cycled...` notifications so I can focus on meaningful turn outcomes.
- As a developer writing log-related tests, I want no `Market cycled...` entry emitted during market cycling so tests do not assert on noise that no longer belongs in the log.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC1 — No `Market cycled...` log entry.** Advancing a turn that cycles unpurchased market cards no longer appends a `Market cycled: N unpurchased cards moved to discard` line to `MainStreetState.activityLog` (including the N=0 edge case — no empty-market message either).
- [ ] **AC2 — Card cycling still works.** Unpurchased market cards are still moved to their respective discard piles and the market is still refilled via `refillSingleRowMarket`; only the log side-effect is removed.
- [ ] **AC3 — No regressions in log callers/tests.** Existing activity-log tests and other `addLog` callers (purchases, income, events, re-roll, incident-deck reshuffle, etc.) are unaffected; any test that previously asserted on `Market cycled...` is updated or removed.
- [ ] **AC4 — Testing/validation.** Unit tests verify that after a market cycle the activity log contains no `Market cycled` entry while the discard/refill side-effects still occurred (e.g. assert on `state.discards.*` and `state.market.cards` rather than on the log line).
- [ ] **AC5 — Documentation updated.** Any docs/comments that list `Market cycled...` as an expected log entry are updated to reflect its removal.
- [ ] **AC6 — Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.**

## Constraints

- Minimal, surgical change: touch only the log emission in `cycleMarketCards`; do not change cycling/refill semantics.
- No new dependencies or schema changes.
- If a doc or test explicitly documents `Market cycled...` as intended log output, that reference must be removed rather than left to rot.

## Existing state

- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetMarket.ts:355` — `cycleMarketCards()` logs `Market cycled: ${visibleCards.length} unpurchased cards moved to discard` (neutral). The surrounding logic moves cards to `state.discards.*` then calls `refillSingleRowMarket()`. No other file emits this string (verified via repo grep).
- `MainStreetState.activityLog` is the append-only log consumed by the HUD. Other `addLog` sites (purchases, income, `refreshMarket`, `replenishIncidentDeck`, etc.) remain in scope and should not be disturbed.
- No existing test asserts specifically on the `Market cycled...` string (grep across `tests/` returned no hits); the closest coverage is `tests/main-street/MainStreetMarketCycling.test.ts` which validates discard/refill determinism. Doc references are limited to a code symbol mention in `docs/main-street/prd-multi-use-card-economy.md`.

## Desired change

- Remove the `addLog(... 'Market cycled...')` call from `cycleMarketCards` in `example-games/main-street/MainStreetMarket.ts`. The conditional `if (visibleCards.length > 0) { addLog(...) }` block should be deleted entirely; the discard loop and `refillSingleRowMarket(state)` call stay.
- Update any tests/docs that assert on or describe the removed log line (none known to assert today, but verify before closing).
- Add/adjust a focused unit test that exercises `cycleMarketCards` (or an end-of-turn path that invokes it) and asserts: (a) no `Market cycled` entry was appended, (b) the cycled cards landed in `state.discards.*`, and (c) the market was refilled.

## Key Files

- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetMarket.ts` — Remove the `Market cycled...` addLog call inside `cycleMarketCards` (around line 354-356).
- `tests/main-street/MainStreetMarketCycling.test.ts` — Update or add assertions that the `Market cycled...` log entry no longer appears while cycling side-effects still hold.
- `tests/main-street/activity-log.test.ts` — Verify no stale assertion on `Market cycled...` (grep today shows none, but re-check at implementation).
- `docs/main-street/prd-multi-use-card-economy.md` — Check that no log-entry documentation still lists `Market cycled...` as expected output (currently only lists the symbol name, no change likely needed, but confirm).

## Related work

- CG-0MQSFGOU30078033 Implement Market Cycling System — Introduced `cycleMarketCards` with the `Market cycled...` log line.
- CG-0MQSFGA60005RNGZ Write Tests for Market Cycling System — Test coverage for cycling/refill determinism.
- CG-0MTGX3XSH005VRUI All resource-mutating log entries gain effective deltas — Explicitly left `Market cycled...` unchanged and noted its removal belongs to CG-0MT5VXSSQ003O5ZC.
- CG-0MSW6INUT003HLP9 Single-row market logic & commands / CG-0MSTOATDT009BRX2 Expand player hand to 3 slots — Established the single-row market and its refill/cycle semantics.

## Risks & assumptions

- **Risk — Hidden consumer of the log line.** Another UI path or analytics hook might filter on `Market cycled` — mitigation: repo-wide grep found no consumer beyond the emission site; implementation must re-grep before closing.
- **Risk — Empty-market edge case.** The current guard `if (visibleCards.length > 0)` means empty markets already emit nothing; removing the block must not introduce a new code path that throws.
- **Assumption — No doc contract depends on this line.** PRD/GDD do not treat `Market cycled...` as a specified player-facing contract; only an implementation log. If review surfaces a spec reference, that spec must be updated in the same change.
- **Scope creep — Broader log hygiene.** Do not expand to rework other log lines (re-roll, reshuffle, scenario) — record any additional log-cleanup ideas as separate discovered work items.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

- Q: "Should the underlying card-cycling and market-refill behavior be preserved, with only the activity-log notification removed?" — Answer (inferred from work-item description — no producer input required): Yes. The item states "We do not need the 'market cycled...' notifications in the Main Street activity log, remove them." and the title is explicitly scoped to the log. No change to `state.discards.*` or `refillSingleRowMarket` is requested. Source: work-item description on CG-0MT5VXSSQ003O5ZC; verified against the emission site at `MainStreetMarket.ts:355` and related comment on CG-0MTGX3XSH005VRUI.
- Q: "Are there any other `Market cycled...`-like housekeeping entries that should also be removed?" — Answer (inferred): No. The work item is narrowly scoped to `Market cycled: N unpurchased cards moved to discard`. Other housekeeping entries (e.g. `Reshuffled incident deck...`) are out of scope and should be tracked as separate items if needed. Open to producer correction — no blocking question filed because the scope is unambiguous.
- No blocking questions were raised with the producer; no `needs-producer-review` flag was set.

## Interview

No interview was required. The work item is a small, well-scoped task with a single unambiguous requirement (remove one log line) and the emission site, related work, and scope were all determinable via repo search. Intake proceeded directly to drafting.

# Show Card Position Outlines in HandView

## Problem Statement

Players have no visual indication of their hand capacity — they cannot see how many additional cards they can hold. Placing light card-position outlines in empty slots solves this.

## Users

- **Player** (Main Street, Golf, etc.) — sees empty hand slots as ghost outlines, knows instantly how many more cards they can buy/hold.
- **Developer** — enables outlines via a single boolean option on HandView construction; no scene-level wiring required.

## Acceptance Criteria

- HandView renders a semi-transparent card-sized rectangle at every position up to `maxSlots`, including occupied positions (ghost outlines behind real cards).
- Outlines are enabled via a new `HandViewOptions.showPositionOutlines: boolean` flag (default `false`).
- Outline rendering respects `reducedMotion` (no animation changes — outlines are static).
- Outlines update correctly on every hand mutation: `setCards()`, `addCard()`, `removeCard()`, `sortCards()` (animated path), and layout changes (`setSpacing()`, `setArcRadius()`, `setLayoutDirection()`, `setBaseX()`, `setBaseY()`).
- Outlines are destroyed on `HandView.destroy()` with no orphaned display objects.
- Unit tests verify outline creation, update, and destruction; a browser test in `GymHandPileScene` verifies visual correctness.

## Constraints

- **Visual style:** Stroke-only (no fill), 2px stroke width, colour `0x666666` at `0.5` alpha, shape `CARD_W x CARD_H` rectangle centred on the card position.
- **When to show:** Always — outlines appear at every slot up to `maxSlots`, including occupied positions (rendered behind real cards).
- **API:** Two new `HandViewOptions` fields: `showPositionOutlines: boolean` (default `false`), `maxSlots: number` (optional — total slots to outline). If `maxSlots` is omitted and `showPositionOutlines` is `true`, outlines render one per current card (matching the occupied-position-only mode).
- **Depth:** Outlines render at depth `index - 0.5` so they sit **behind** card sprites (depth `index`) but above any background elements. If Phaser depth sorting proves unreliable, use a dedicated render group.
- **Layout direction:** Outlines must handle both `'horizontal'` and `'vertical'` layout directions.

## Existing State

- `HandView` (`src/ui/HandView.ts`) manages card sprite creation, layout (`layoutCardPositions`), selection, drag-and-drop, and event emission.
- No outline or ghost-rendering code exists in HandView or related UI modules.
- Game state already tracks hand capacity (e.g., `maxHandSize` in Main Street) — outlines would simply visualise the gap between current hand count and capacity.

## Desired Change

- Add `showPositionOutlines` and `maxSlots` to `HandViewOptions`.
- Add `private outlineRects: Phaser.GameObjects.Rectangle[]` field.
- In `rebuildDisplay()`, after creating card sprites, create outline rectangles for positions `0..maxSlots-1` (or `0..cards.length-1` if `maxSlots` is not set).
- In `applyLayout()`, reposition outline rectangles to match the new card positions.
- In `destroy()`, call `outlineRects.forEach(r => r.destroy())` and clear the array.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `src/ui/HandView.ts` — Add `showPositionOutlines`, `maxSlots`, outline rendering, layout updates, destruction
- `src/ui/constants.ts` — No changes needed (uses existing `CARD_W`/`CARD_H`)
- `example-games/gym/scenes/GymHandPileScene.ts` — Add a slider/button to toggle outline preview
- `tests/ui/HandView.outlines.test.ts` — Unit tests for outline lifecycle

## Related Work

- `CG-0MS937FT9006273E` — Gym Hand & Pile: selection highlight renders over cards to the right (completed; depth ordering reference)
- `GymHandPileScene` — canonical Gym scene for HandView testing

## Risks & Assumptions

- **Scope creep:** Outlines are strictly visual — no click interaction, no animation. Animated entrance effects are a follow-up.

# Intake Brief — Turn cash calculations wrong (CG-0MTINZ5GG007BH44)

## Problem Statement

Starting a turn with 6 coins, placing Arcade (-4, listed income 2.3 / rep 0.05), HUD tooltip, IncomePhase log, and incident resolution disagree: tooltip shows 2.9 → 2.974 at ×1.0 (rep 1), business log shows 3.009 / 0.05, turn net shows +2.991 coins / -0.95 rep, and business costs (-1) + noise complaint (-1 coin, -1 rep) are applied inconsistently. The turn cash flow has no single source of truth, so players cannot reconcile what they should earn vs what they receive.

## Users

- **Player tracking economy** — "As a player, after placing Arcade with 6 coins, I want the HUD tooltip, income breakdown, and activity log to show the same pre/post-reputation income and net deltas so I can trust my coin balance."
- **QA / balancing** — "As QA, I want one auditable coin-flow formula (placement cost → base income + synergy + staff buffs → rep multiplier → active effects → ongoing costs → incident) exercised by a regression test for the reported 6-coin Arcade scenario."
- **Designer tuning difficulty** — "As a designer, I want `reputationCoinDivisor` / `reputationCoinMultiplier` and `applyReputationMultiplier` to be the sole multiplier path so tuning changes propagate everywhere."

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **Single source of truth audit**: Document the intended turn cash formula end-to-end (dayStart snapshot → placement deduction → `applyIncome` breakdown → staff/community/business ongoing costs → `resolveIncident` → `appendTurnNetRow`) and show each HUD/log value maps to one term. Fix divergent paths so `buildCoinsTooltip` and `applyIncome`/`IncomeResult.phaseBreakdown` agree on base, post-rep, and rep multiplier (tooltip ×1.0 vs 2.974/2.9 ≈1.025 must be resolved — formatting, divisor, or double-count).
- [ ] **Tooltip + display corrected**: Reputation multiplier display matches `reputationCoinMultiplier(rep, config)` for the turn's actual reputation (at start vs after placement vs after income) with correct rounding; "income before reputation" equals sum of producing slots' `currentIncome` (buffed where applicable) without double-counting synergy/hand synergy.
- [ ] **End-of-turn net reconciled**: For the reported scenario (and a deterministic test that reproduces it: 6 coins, place Arcade costing 4, income ≈2.3–2.9 base, -1 business upkeep, noise complaint -1/-1), `Turn N net: +X coins, +Y rep` equals `coinsNow - dayStartCoins` / `repNow - dayStartRep` and decomposes exactly into `income + incident + costs`; activity log ordering remains `income → costs → incident → net row`.
- [ ] **Regression + coverage**: Add/repair unit test(s) exercising the reported numbers (before/after rep, ongoing costs, incident) and `buildCoinsTooltip` vs `applyIncome`; all pre-existing Main Street income/adjacency/reputation tests continue to pass.
- [ ] **Docs updated**: Code comments on the chosen multiplier timing (when rep is sampled) and `docs/DEVELOPER.md` economy note if formula changes.
- [ ] **Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.**

## Constraints

- Deterministic, seeded RNG — income/incident must remain reproducible per seed.
- Do not introduce a second multiplier formula; `MainStreetDifficulty.reputationCoinMultiplier` / `applyReputationMultiplier` is canonical.
- Preserve log classification (`gain`/`loss`/`neutral` via `classifyEffect`/`describeEventEffects`) and per-turn net row as the final entry of a completed turn.
- Minimal scope: fix calculation/display divergence; do not redesign difficulty presets or card data unless the audit proves they are the root cause.

## Existing State

- `applyIncome` in `MainStreetAdjacency.ts` builds phasing-aware totals (staff per-business buffs, active `income-multiplier`/`rep-multiplier` effects, `applyReputationMultiplier`, hand synergy) and logs `Income: +X.XXX coins`.
- `buildCoinsTooltip` in `scenes/MainStreetHudTooltips.ts` independently sums `card.currentIncome` and calls `applyReputationMultiplier` for its "Before/After reputation" lines (formatting to 3 decimals, multiplier to 1 decimal) — yet reporter sees ×1.0 with a 2.5% lift, suggesting rounding/divisor or stale `currentIncome`.
- `MainStreetEngine.processEndOfTurn` sequences `cycleMarketCards → IncomePhase(applyIncome+ongoing costs) → IncidentPhase(resolveIncident) → EndCheck → appendTurnNetRow`; ongoing costs are deducted after income and incident deltas after that.
- Cards cache `currentIncome`/`currentReputationPerTurn` via `recalculateCard`/`updateNeighborsOnPlacement`; legacy/placement paths may leave stale caches.
- `MainStreetDifficulty.reputationCoinMultiplier(rep) = 1 + rep/divisor` (capped), clamped to ≥1.0 for negative rep.

## Desired Change

- Audit and align all coin-flow contributors to one formula and one sampling point for reputation; make `buildCoinsTooltip` consume `getIncomeResult`/`applyIncome`'s phase breakdown (or a shared pure helper) instead of re-deriving.
- Fix multiplier display (1-decimal rounding hides ~1.025 — show 2–3 decimals or correct divisor) and ensure tooltip's "before" matches the sum actually credited before rep multiplier.
- Reconcile ongoing-cost deduction (-1 business cost) and incident noise complaint (-1/-1) timing so net row arithmetic is transparent and matches theHUD.
- Land a regression test that locks the reported 6-coin Arcade turn and a `buildCoinsTooltip` vs `applyIncome` consistency check.

## Key Files

- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetAdjacency.ts` — `applyIncome`, `computeBusinessIncome`, `computeSynergyBonus`, `computeHandCardSynergyBonus`, `phaseBreakdown` assembly
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngine.ts` — `processEndOfTurn`, `applyStaffOngoingCosts`, `applyCommunitySpaceOngoingCosts`, `applyBusinessOngoingCosts`, `resolveIncident`, `appendTurnNetRow`
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetDifficulty.ts` — `reputationCoinMultiplier`, `applyReputationMultiplier`, `reputationCoinDivisor` config
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetHudTooltips.ts` — `buildCoinsTooltip`, `getIncomeResult`, multiplier formatting
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetState.ts` — `MainStreetState`, `resourceBank`/`ledger` sync, `addLog`/`describeEventEffects`/`classifyEffect`
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetCards.ts` — Arcade card definition (baseIncome 2.3, rep 0.05, synergy rates) and CSV-derived data
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetTurnController.ts` — end-turn sequencing, income/incident animation triggers
- `tests/main-street/staff-skill-buffs.test.ts` / `staff-skill-stacking.test.ts` / `monte-carlo-balance.test.ts` — existing income/reputation coverage to keep green
- `docs/DEVELOPER.md` — economy formula note if formula/timing changes

## Related Work

Potentially related work items:

- `Sell cards in Main Street (CG-0MQOA5U4H000J37N)` — completed — sell semantics affect income/rep contributions; verifies "sold stays as synergy anchor" (CG-0MT5XUE2200047IJ) does not re-break totals.
- `When selling a businesses in Main Street sale price should reflect value of business (CG-0MT5XO7DI0066QCT)` — open — sale-price vs ongoing-value touches the same coin-flow surface.
- `Per-owner income routing; shared event/incident resolution (CG-0MTIIL6J200291ZQ)` — open — upcoming per-owner IncomePhase split may need the same single-source fix applied.

Potentially related docs:

- `example-games/main-street/README.md` — card economy overview
- `docs/DEVELOPER.md` — testing / building guidance; economy tuning notes
- `docs/gym/GYM_INDEX.md` — scene→API map for SLL/HUD patterns (reference for tooltip HUD conventions)

## Risks & Assumptions

- **Risk:** `currentIncome` cache staleness (direct `streetGrid` writes, undo/redo, legacy saves) silently diverges tooltip from credited income. *Mitigation:* add cache-freshness assertion in `buildCoinsTooltip`/`getIncomeResult` and a failing-before-fix repro test.
- **Risk:** Multiplier rounding masks a real 2–3% error (×1.0 display vs ~1.025 credit). *Mitigation:* require 2–3 decimal display or prove 1-decimal is intentional; lock divisor in test.
- **Risk:** Fixing one surface (e.g., removing double-counted synergy) breaks balance expectations elsewhere. *Mitigation:* run `monte-carlo-balance` and full unit suite; treat balance shift as follow-up work item if needed.
- **Risk:** Scope creep — "conduct a full evaluation" could expand to rebalancing all cards. *Mitigation:* audit is diagnostic; only math/display convergence ships in this bug — rebalance is a new child/item.
- **Assumption:** Arcade's `baseIncome`+`synergyCoinBonus` / CSV data are correct; bug is in aggregation/multiplier/display, not card data. Validated during audit — if data is wrong, correct it and note in the fix.
- **Assumption:** Incident "Noise Complaint" is `-1 coin, -1 rep` per design (card `coinDelta`/`reputationDelta`); staff incident-mitigation buffs should be accounted for in the incident delta if employed.

## Appendix: Clarifying Questions & Answers

No interview was required — seed report provided the repro scenario (6 coins → Arcade placement → income/rep/incident numbers) and requested a full evaluation. # Do not show new market cards until turn has ended

## Problem statement

When the player clicks "End Turn", the market cards are cycled (old cards discarded, new cards dealt from deck) **immediately** inside `processEndOfTurn()`, before income calculation, incident resolution, and the 800ms delay. This leaves the player staring at newly dealt market cards while income/incident animations and log updates play out — a jarring disconnect where the player is looking at the next day's market before their current turn has finished resolving.

## Users

- **User story:** As a Main Street player, I want the market to stay unchanged during my turn's end-of-turn resolution (income, incidents, notifications) so I can see the full financial summary of the turn I just played.
- **User story:** As a player, I want the new market cards to appear only when the next day begins, giving me a clean visual transition between turns.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC1:** Clicking "End Turn" no longer cycles the market cards. The old market cards remain visible during income calculation, incident resolution, and the income-feedback display.
- **AC2:** The market cards are cycled and refilled at the **start** of the next day (inside `startDayPhase()` / `executeDayStart()`), so the player sees the new market alongside the "Day N" transition banner.
- **AC3:** All existing unit tests pass, including `MainStreetMarketCycling.test.ts` and `staff-general-market-state.test.ts`. No regression in market cycling correctness.
- **AC4:** Tutorial gameplay is unaffected — scenario-placed market cards are still preserved across the day boundary as before.
- **AC5:** Competitive mode (multi-player) is unaffected — the same market-cycling behavior applies at the correct point in the closing phases.

## Constraints

- The `cycleMarketCards()` function itself is **not changed** — only its call site moves.
- The tutorial's `skipMarketCycleOnEndTurn` flag and related guard code can be **removed** since cycling no longer happens during end-of-turn processing.
- The market must still be refilled at day start — only the timing of the cycle changes (from end of old turn → start of new turn).

## Existing state

Market cards are cycled at the beginning of `processEndOfTurn()` in `MainStreetEngine.ts`:
- **Line ~1430-1431** (single-player): `if (!state.skipMarketCycleOnEndTurn) { cycleMarketCards(state); }`
- **Line ~1212** (competitive): `if (!state.skipMarketCycleOnEndTurn) cycleMarketCards(state);`

Then income, incidents, and notifications play — the player sees the new cards during this wait.

## Desired change

1. **Remove** the `cycleMarketCards(state)` call from `processEndOfTurn()` (line ~1430-1431) and `resolveCompetitiveClosingPhases()` (line ~1212).
2. **Add** a `cycleMarketCards(state)` call in `executeDayStart()` right after the `refillMarket(state)` call (after line ~1264 in `MainStreetEngine.ts`). This ensures cycling happens at the start of each new day.
3. **Remove** the `skipMarketCycleOnEndTurn` state field, its guard in `processEndOfTurn()`, and its setting/clearing in `MainStreetTurnController.endTurn()`.
4. The `executeCompetitiveDay` path (line ~1334) that calls `refillMarket` in `executeDayStart` already has a `skipMarketRefill` parameter — the new `cycleMarketCards` call should follow the same skip logic (skip on checkpoint resume).

## Key Files (predicted)

- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngine.ts` — Move `cycleMarketCards` from `processEndOfTurn()` and `resolveCompetitiveClosingPhases()` to `executeDayStart()`
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetTurnController.ts` — Remove `skipMarketCycleOnEndTurn` guard in `endTurn()`
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetState.ts` — Remove `skipMarketCycleOnEndTurn` state field (~line 377)
- `tests/main-street/MainStreetMarketCycling.test.ts` — Verify tests still pass (they call `cycleMarketCards` directly, so no change needed)
- `example-games/main-street/TutorialScenario.ts` — Review if any scenario assumptions about market timing need updating

## Related work

- CG-0MM8MZ8IK0TCYV79 — Add visible game activity log to Main Street UI (income/incident logging)
- CG-0MT5W7UJJ0065MEZ — Main Street log should show total effects (per-turn net summary)
- CG-0MSP26Q5N002EH8P — Tutorial: two-turn plan-ahead flow (uses `skipMarketCycleOnEndTurn` to preserve scenario cards)

## Risks & Assumptions

- **Risk:** The tutorial's `skipMarketCycleOnEndTurn` flag also suppresses cycling — removing it could cause scenario cards to be lost on end-turn. **Mitigation:** The cycle now happens in `startDayPhase()` which the tutorial already goes through, so scenario cards should still be preserved by `refillMarket()`'s top-up semantics (visible cards are preserved, only missing slots are drawn).
- **Assumption:** The `refillMarket()` top-up semantics (preserve visible cards, only draw into empty slots) correctly preserve scenario cards. If not, the scenario system may need an additional guard in `executeDayStart()`.
- **Scope creep:** This change only affects the timing of market cycling. No changes to market composition, card deal animations, or income calculation logic.
- **Assumption:** Competitive mode only calls `processEndOfTurn()` / `resolveCompetitiveClosingPhases()` from `executeCompetitiveDay()`, which in turn calls `executeDayStart()` for the next day — the new cycle location applies uniformly.

# Intake Brief: Grand Opening card can only be played in the same turn as a business is opened (CG-0MTIOCBH400970OB)

**Priority: Medium** | **Type: Feature** | **Assignee: Map**

> Restrict Grand Opening Sale (`evt-grand-opening`) so it can only be played from hand during a turn in which a business has been placed onto the street grid; all other play timing remains unchanged.

## Problem Statement

The Grand Opening Sale Investment event (`evt-grand-opening`) can currently be played on any turn it is held, which dilutes its thematic tie to opening a new business. The desired mechanic is a same-turn combo: the event should only be playable in the turn a business is placed onto the street, rewarding coordinated play.

## Users

- **Player:** Wants the Grand Opening card to feel like a celebration of a new opening, with clear feedback about when it can be used.
  - *"As a player, I want to play Grand Opening Sale only on a turn where I opened a business, so the reward feels earned and the timing is meaningful."*
- **Game Designer / Balancer:** Needs the restriction enforced consistently across all placement paths and visible to AI/balance tooling.
  - *"As a designer, I want Grand Opening's play window enforced in the engine's legality layer so balance assumptions about its frequency hold."*

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **Turn-gated play for Grand Opening:** `evt-grand-opening` can be played from hand (`play-event-from-hand` / `play-event`) only when a business has been placed onto the street during the current turn (Day). Attempts to play it in a turn with no placement are rejected as illegal (legality check returns `legal: false` with a clear reason; UI shows illegal-move shake/feedback and no state mutation).
2. **All placement paths arm the gate:** The "business placed this turn" flag is set by every street-placement path — `playBusinessFromHand`, `purchaseBusiness` (direct buy-and-place via market), and `buy-and-place` composite — and is checked by the Grand Opening legality. Verified by unit coverage for each path (same-turn placement → Grand Opening playable; no placement → blocked).
3. **Gate lifecycle:** The flag resets at `DayStart` (new day) and does not carry over; placing multiple businesses in one turn keeps the gate open for that turn only. Holding Grand Opening across turns without a placement keeps it unplayable until a new placement occurs.
4. **No regression for other events:** All other Investment events (e.g. Local Festival, free Community Garden, etc.) remain playable any turn they are held and affordable, subject only to existing action/coin/hand rules. Existing event tests and tutorial flows continue to pass.
5. **Testing & validation:** Unit tests cover the gating (allowed vs blocked cases, reset on new day, each placement path, and coin/action edge cases); at least one browser/interaction check confirms illegal-play feedback; `npm run build` succeeds.
6. **All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.**
7. **Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.**

## Constraints

- **CSV is source of truth unchanged:** No schema change to `card-data.csv`; `evt-grand-opening` row stays as `SpecificSynergy/Commerce` with existing cost/deltas. Gating is engine logic, not data.
- **Legality-layer enforcement:** The restriction must live in the engine's legality helpers (`canPlayEvent` / `playEventFromHand` and the `executeAction` play-event path), not only in the scene/UI, so headless, AI, and replay paths respect it.
- **Deterministic per turn:** Same seed + same action sequence produces the same allowed/blocked outcome; no extra RNG consumed for the gate.
- **AI respects the gate:** AI strategy skips `evt-grand-opening` when the turn gate is not satisfied.
- **Backwards-compatible save shape:** Any new state field (e.g. `businessPlacedThisTurn` / `placedBusinessIdsThisTurn`) must have a safe default and migration for old saves.

## Existing State

- **Event model:** Investment events are moved to hand for free (`moveToHand` / `purchaseEvent` with cost 0) and played from hand via `playEventFromHand` / `playEventCommand`, paying `card.cost` at play time and resolving `SpecificSynergy` effects (see `MainStreetMarket.playEventFromHand`, `MainStreetEngine.executeAction` play-event cases).
- **Current legality for events:** `canPlayEvent` checks hand index, family `event`, trigger `Investment`, same-day composite action waiver, `actionsRemaining`, and `coins`; no placement check. `canPurchaseEvent` is hand-capacity only. `resolveEvent` for `SpecificSynergy` counts matching businesses on the grid.
- **Placement paths:** Businesses/community-spaces reach the grid via `purchaseBusiness`, `playBusinessFromHand` (cost-at-play), and `buyAndPlaceBusiness` (+50% premium drag path). Turn-scoped flags already exist for same-day composites (`justMovedHandCardId`, `justMovedEventCardId`, `justMovedUpgradeCardId`); business placement has no turn-scoped "placed this turn" flag yet.
- **Card identity:** `evt-grand-opening` ("Grand Opening Sale", cost 3, `SpecificSynergy/Commerce`, `coinDelta 4.5`) is an Investment-trigger event; other Investment events share the same family/trigger but should not be gated.

## Desired Change

### 1. Turn-scoped placement flag

- Add a per-turn flag to `MainStreetState` (e.g. `businessPlacedThisTurn: boolean` or `businessPlacedTurn: number | null`), initialized to `false`/`null`, set to `true` whenever a business or community-space card is successfully placed onto `streetGrid` (all three placement paths), and reset to `false` in `executeDayStart` / `executeCompetitiveDayStart` (DayStart). Competitive mode shares the same day, so the flag is shared for the day. Persist with a safe default and backfill in `deserialize`/`migrate`.

### 2. Gate Grand Opening on the flag

- In `canPlayEvent` (and the underlying `playEventFromHand` validation) and in `executeAction`'s `play-event` / `play-event-from-hand` branches, when the target card id is `evt-grand-opening` (or name "Grand Opening Sale"), require `businessPlacedThisTurn === true`; otherwise return `legal: false` with a message like "Grand Opening Sale can only be played on a turn where you opened a business." `purchaseEvent` (move to hand) stays ungated — the card can be acquired any turn, only playing is gated.

- Surface illegal-play feedback via the existing `shakeIllegalMove` / instruction-text path when the scene attempts the gated play outside the window.

### 3. AI and docs

- Update `MainStreetAiStrategy` scoring/filtering so the AI does not select `evt-grand-opening` when the gate is closed.
- Update `docs/main-street/card-catalog.md` entry for `evt-grand-opening` (effect/timing note), `example-games/main-street/README.md` or card-data comments, and the engine's `AGENTS.md` / `docs/DEVELOPER.md` if the turn-gate pattern is described.

## Key Files

- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetState.ts` — Add `businessPlacedThisTurn` (or equivalent) to `MainStreetState`, initialize in `createInitialState`/`createMainStreetState`, reset on DayStart, handle save/load migration.
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetMarket.ts` — Gate `canPlayEvent` / `playEventFromHand` for `evt-grand-opening` on the new flag; set the flag in `purchaseBusiness`, `playBusinessFromHand`, `buyAndPlaceBusiness` (or centralize in the callers).
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngine.ts` — Reset flag in `executeDayStart` / `executeCompetitiveDayStart`; enforce gate in `executeAction` play-event branches if not already covered by market legality; wire `consumeAction` ordering.
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetAiStrategy.ts` — Filter/score `evt-grand-opening` against the gate in legal-action selection.
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetTurnController.ts` — Surface illegal-play feedback for the gated case (if not already via engine error path).
- `docs/main-street/card-catalog.md` — Document new timing restriction for Grand Opening Sale.
- `tests/main-street/**` — New/updated unit coverage for the gate (allowed vs blocked, reset, each placement path); browser smoke for shake/feedback.

## Related work

- **Market / hand economy (CG-0MSTOATDT009BRX2)** [completed]: Unified single-row market, move-to-hand is free, play-from-hand pays cost-at-play — the layer this gate builds on. `MainStreetMarket.moveToHand` / `playBusinessFromHand` / `playEventFromHand`.
- **Event cost-at-play (CG-0MT5W1V4D007NN8Q)** [completed]: Investment events moved to hand free, cost paid on play — establishes the `justMovedEventCardId` / `canPlayEvent` pattern the gate will extend.
- **Business placement premium (CG-0MT24X0SX007RLHN)** [completed]: Same-day composite vs plan-ahead pricing for `playBusinessFromHand` / `buy-and-place` — the placement paths that must arm the gate.
- **Tutorial T7: Replace Grand Opening with Local Festival (CG-0MR481920006RAO5)** [completed]: Tutorial no longer hinges on `evt-grand-opening` in the investments row; reduces blast radius for this change.
- **Upgrade buy-and-place premium (CG-0MT3IYSRL001VVUP)** [in progress/open]: Parallel +50% premium pattern for upgrades — not gated, but shares placement plumbing.
- **Core engine: charge an action for event move/play (CG-0MTH5CA9R0023PKU)** [open]: Action-economy work that touches `canPlayEvent` / `executeAction` event paths; coordinate to avoid double-charging the gated play.

## Risks & Assumptions

### Risks

- **Scope creep — card-specific rule in generic event plumbing:** Adding a per-card exception to generic event legality could invite more card-specific branches. Mitigation: isolate the check to `card.id === 'evt-grand-opening'` (or a `requiresBusinessPlacedThisTurn` flag on the card type if preferred) with a single enforcement point; record further card-specific timing ideas as separate work items.
- **Missed placement path:** If any business-placement entry point is missed, the gate appears flaky. Mitigation: enumerate and test all three paths (`purchaseBusiness`, `playBusinessFromHand`, `buyAndPlaceBusiness`) plus competitive shared-day.
- **Save compatibility:** Old saves lacking the new flag must not break. Mitigation: default `false` and backfill in deserialization.
- **AI / Monte Carlo drift:** Gating reduces Grand Opening frequency, shifting economy balance. Mitigation: AI respects the gate; Monte Carlo guardrails reviewed if scores shift materially.

### Assumptions

- The restriction applies only to **playing** `evt-grand-opening` from hand, not to acquiring it (moving to hand remains free any turn). If the producer intends acquisition to also be gated, the brief will be amended.
- "Business is opened" means a **business or community-space** card placed onto `streetGrid` this turn (both families occupy grid slots). If only `business` family should count, the implementation will narrow the flag to `card.family === 'business'`.
- The gate is **turn-scoped** (resets at `DayStart`), not phase-scoped; multiple placements in one turn keep it open for that turn.
- No change to `evt-grand-opening`'s CSV cost, synergy target, or deltas; only play legality changes.

## Appendix: Clarifying Questions & Answers

1. **Q: Does "business is opened" include community-space cards (which also occupy the street grid) or only `family === 'business'`?**
   - A: Assumed to include both `business` and `community-space` placements (they share the same `streetGrid` placement plumbing). Source: assumption for intake; to be confirmed by producer. If the producer wants business-only, narrow the flag to `card.family === 'business'`. Status: **OPEN QUESTION** — confirm family scope.

2. **Q: Should acquiring Grand Opening to hand also be gated, or only playing it?**
   - A: Assumed only **playing** is gated; `moveToHand`/`purchaseEvent` for `evt-grand-opening` stays free any turn. Source: assumption for intake; aligns with existing "move free, pay on play" model (CG-0MT5W1V4D007NN8Q). Status: **OPEN QUESTION** — confirm acquisition vs play scope.

3. **Q: Is the gate per-turn (Day) or per-phase? Does placing multiple businesses extend the window?**
   - A: Assumed per-turn (Day), reset at `DayStart`; multiple placements keep the gate open for that turn only. Source: assumption based on issue title "same turn." Status: **OPEN QUESTION** — confirm reset boundary.

4. **Q: Should the gate apply to the direct buy-and-place drag path that places a business and could then play Grand Opening in the same MarketPhase?**
   - A: Assumed yes — any successful `streetGrid` placement arms the gate for the remainder of that turn's `MarketPhase`, so a drag-placed business followed by Grand Opening in the same phase is legal. Source: assumption; to be confirmed. Status: **OPEN QUESTION**.

## Related work (automated report)

_To be populated by `/skill:find-related`._
